internal_alignment: Add within 100, including adding a two-digit number and a one-digit number and adding a two-digit number and a multiple of 10, using concrete models and place-value strategies, relating the strategy to a written method; in adding two-digit numbers, one adds tens and tens, ones and ones, and sometimes it is necessary to compose a ten. Internal record only; no standards codes appear on any child page, and no separate answer key is published for this pack.
model_accuracy: Base-ten models match the Tens and Ones to 100 pack exactly (turquoise ten-rods of 10 joined cubes, gold one-cubes). Every sum stays within 100. No carried-digit algorithm anywhere. Regrouping is shown as clearly separated steps: combine ones, circle 10 ones, exchange for 1 ten, count remaining tens and ones; the circled ones and the new ten rod never share a counting display. Page 4 is visual-only with no addition equations. Page 7's word-problem exchange area tells the child to draw all 12 ones first, so the 5 and 7 ones are combined before exchanging.
pack: Grade 1 Math: Adding Tens and Ones Within 100

pages_detail.activities: Worked example plus two problems: a two-digit model plus added ten-rods, recording tens, ones, and sum in large boxes
pages_detail.title: Add Tens

pages_detail.activities: Worked example plus two problems: a two-digit model plus added ones, recording tens, ones, and sum; a single closing question asks whether the tens changed
pages_detail.title: Add Ones

pages_detail.activities: No regrouping. Worked example plus two spacious problems: two addend models, then the child draws the combined model in a dashed frame and records tens, ones, and sum
pages_detail.title: Add Tens and Ones Together

pages_detail.activities: Visual-only exchange activity, no addition equations. Worked example as an explicit before-and-after sequence (13 ones with 10 circled, then a separate display of exactly 1 ten rod and 3 ones). Three practice groups: circle 10 ones, color the new ten rod, record 1 ten and the leftover ones
pages_detail.title: Make a Group of 10

pages_detail.activities: Two-digit plus one-digit regrouping. Worked example in four separated steps (combine 12 ones; circle 10; trade for 1 ten rod, 2 left; count 5 tens and 2 ones). Two supported problems with combined ones pre-drawn, a new-ten slot, and Tens/Ones/Sum boxes
pages_detail.title: Add Ones and Make a New Ten

pages_detail.activities: Two-digit plus two-digit regrouping. Worked example from both addend models through four separated steps, ending with the count spelled out (3 tens, 2 tens, and 1 new ten make 6 tens). One supported problem with combined ones pre-drawn, a new-ten slot, and Tens/Ones/Sum boxes
pages_detail.title: Add Two-Digit Numbers with a New Ten

pages_detail.activities: Short mixed review: three large equations with Tens/Ones/Sum boxes, then one illustrated word problem (Sam's apples) with addend models, answer boxes, and a full-width dashed Make a new ten area where the child draws all 12 ones, circles 10, and draws 1 new ten rod
pages_detail.title: Let's Practice Adding
